name: Thursday Night House Party

date.source: The promotion's own correction post of 23 April 2001, fixing the card's date after an earlier posting misstated it as 2000.

notes: Main Event Championship Wrestling's first card since a nine-month hiatus. The promotion's own report names no opponent for the Hardcore Championship win.

name: Main Event

date.source: No date is given for this broadcast; it is reported after the fact in a 7 May 2001 post.

matches.note: Eastland defeated Irons for the Hardcore Championship in what the promotion's own report called a stunning upset.

notes: The Misfits also won the Tag Team Championship on this broadcast; the promotion's own report does not name their opponents. The same report previews a vacant Television Championship match between Corey Irons and the Iron Predator “on Wednesday”; see the 9 May 2001 result.

name: MECW: Corey Irons vs. the Iron Predator, 9 May 2001

date.source: Both the preview (7 May) and result (11 May) posts date the match only as ‘Wednesday’; the single Wednesday between those two posts is 9 May 2001.

matches.note: Irons defeated the Iron Predator; the win also gave him a first-round bye in the World Championship tournament.

name: MECW: Johnny Eastland vs. Jaguar

date.source: Reported in a 7 June 2001 post as already complete; no specific date for the match itself is given.

matches.note: Eastland defeated Jaguar, billed as a rising star.

notes: The same post previews two further matches: Eastland and Jaguar were to face the Misfits for the Tag Team Championship ‘next Wednesday’, and Eastland was promised a rematch with World Champion Corey Irons ‘this Sunday’; the held record ends before either is reported.

name: Hell Night

date.source: The promotion's own 23 May 2001 announcement names Saturday, 26 May 2001, as its first pay-per-view.

appearances.source: the promotion's own 23 May 2001 announcement, naming him among four wrestlers drawing first-round byes
the promotion's own 23 May 2001 announcement, naming him among four wrestlers drawing first-round byes

matches.note: Irons became the first MECW World Champion; the semifinal that set up this final is not detailed in the held record.

notes: Four wrestlers — Corey Irons, Johnny Eastland, Doyle and the Iron Predator — drew first-round byes into the tournament per the promotion's own 23 May 2001 preview; only the final result survives.
